### Listen Carefully
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/listen-carefully-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-15.html
Passage: Psalm 85:8
Points:
- Constant activity and hurry often make it difficult for believers to stop and listen to God.
- Failing to pay attention leads to missing God's direction entirely or living in spiritual confusion.
- The psalmist committed to listen because the Lord promises peace to His faithful servants.
- Past generations suffered disaster because they neglected God's voice and turned back to folly.
- Attentively hearing God through His Word and teachers brings deep joy and protects against foolish paths.

### The Awakening We Need: Why the Reformed Pray for Revival
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-awakening-we-need
Passage: Psalm 85:6
Points:
- Authentic revival is an extraordinary divine miracle rather than a humanly engineered program.
- Believers must recognize their pervasive weakness and moral faltering to see their need for renewal.
- Spiritual awakening begins among God's own people when they humble themselves before Him.
- The ultimate mark and fruit of true revival is overflowing, experiential joy in Christ.

### Revival in the Making: God’s Central Means for Spiritual Renewal
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/revival-in-the-making
Passage: Psalm 85:6, 8
Points:
- The chief goal of genuine biblical revival is that God's people freshly rejoice in Him.
- Spiritual renewal starts with God's voice, igniting the Holy Spirit's fire upon the wood of Scripture.
- Great biblical awakenings were consistently fueled by rediscovering, reading, and teaching the Word.
- Necessary grief over sin is transformed by God's mercy into the protective stronghold of joy.
- Persistent prayer for corporate renewal must be paired with daily devotion to Scripture.

### Will We See Revival in Our Nation Again?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-april-28-2021.html
Passage: Psalm 85:6
Points:
- Nations tend to slide through a cycle from spiritual faith and liberty into apathy and bondage.
- A sweeping spiritual revival is the vital remedy for cultural and moral decline.
- God calls His people to take their stand in prayer and intercede for awakening.
- No matter how far a nation has drifted, it is never too late for God to restore and revive.
